Class SyntheticEye

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.vision.SyntheticEye
public final class SyntheticEye extends Object
Draws what a fighter would see of one opponent, for a body that has no screen (a fake player on the server). The opponent is the game's own player model (PlayerFigure), posed and animated the way the game would, in the key colours. The picture then goes through the same MaskExtractor as a real frame, so the masks and statistics come out in exactly the form the network was trained on.

What it does not draw: whatever the opponent holds, and anything in the world that could hide it. Like the real picture it holds nothing but the opponent's shape on screen. Not thread-safe.
